ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\angle AOB$ is a right angle, $OC$ is the bisector of $\angle AOB$, and $\angle AOD = 2\angle BOD$. What is the measure of $\angle COD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle AOB$ is a right angle, and OC bisects $\angle AOB$,

$\therefore$ $\angle AOB=90^\circ$, $\angle AOC=\angle BOC=45^\circ$,

Since $\angle AOD=2\angle BOD$, and $\angle AOD+\angle BOD=90^\circ$,

$\therefore$ $\angle DOB=30^\circ$,

$\therefore$ $\angle COD=\angle BOC−\angle DOB=45^\circ−30^\circ=\boxed{15^\circ}$.
